title: 航空引擎健康監測
summary: 以「讓引擎趨勢異常與工況、感測及模型邊界分開」為主線，在合成引擎健康趨勢與振動資料室中依序完成多來源資料的時間年齡、轉速相關頻率追蹤、感測零偏的長時間影響、告警精確率與漏報平衡、可信區間與感測誤差來源及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
summaryEn: Follow Separate engine trend anomalies from operating condition, sensors and model limits in a Synthetic engine-health trends and vibration data room, progressing through Time age of multi-source data, Speed-related frequency tracking, Long-duration sensor-bias effects, Alert precision and missed-event balance, Uncertainty sources and confidence interpretation, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

steps.title: 多來源資料的時間年齡：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Time age of multi-source data: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 多來源資料的時間年齡 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Time age of multi-source data and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「航空引擎健康監測」中，本單元處理「多來源資料的時間年齡」。顯示端必須知道資料產生時間；更新很頻繁仍可能顯示已延遲的封包。
steps.instructionEn: Within Aircraft engine health monitoring, this unit examines Time age of multi-source data. Displays need source timestamps; frequent refreshes may still show delayed packets.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想台架，與其他單元尺寸及負載不可直接拼接。原創教學假設，非機型實測或操作值：量測時間t0=10.00 s、顯示時間t1=10.12 s。關係式 age=t1-t0；含輸出單位換算的算式 10.12-10，結果 0.12 s。適用範圍：時鐘已同步；不同時鐘漂移需另校正。
steps.observationEn: This unit uses an independent hypothetical bench; dimensions and loads must not be combined with other units without reconciliation. Original teaching assumptions, not aircraft measurements or operating settings: Measurement time t0=10.00 s and display time t1=10.12 s. Relation age=t1-t0; evaluated expression including output-unit conversion 10.12-10 gives 0.12 s. Applicability: Clocks are synchronized; clock drift requires separate correction.
steps.failure: 在「多來源資料的時間年齡」的情境中，舊封包晚到卻覆蓋新封包會使顯示狀態倒退。
steps.failureEn: In the context of Time age of multi-source data, A late old packet overwriting a newer one can make displayed state regress.

steps.checkEn: For Time age of multi-source data, Retain measurement, reception and rendering timestamps in synthetic packets and decompose delay. Retain units, conditions and raw calculations, and compare one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「航空引擎健康監測」的「多來源資料的時間年齡：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出機體、能源、感測、控制與地面驗證的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「座艙模擬器：回應之前」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與試件構型、質量或負載表、原始量測與需求版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Time age of multi-source data: Mechanism and observation” in “Aircraft engine health monitoring”. Draw the airframe, energy, sensing, control and ground-verification interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Cockpit Simulator: Before the Response” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for specimen configuration, mass/load manifest, raw measurements and requirement version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.
